caption: The drawing features a rectangular plaque with a scene depicted in shades of gray. Within the plaque, there is a bear positioned on the right side, walking towards the left. On the left side of the plaque, there are large leafy plants. Above the bear and to the right, there is a butterfly. The ground beneath the bear displays its paw prints. The plaque itself has a defined border, and the entire composition is centered against a plain, untextured background. The overall coloration is monochromatic, utilizing various intensities of gray.
title: Relief Panel of Bear
